target_customer: Professionals and companies that build PowerPoint decks and need brand-consistent slides
problem: Making professional slides that follow company templates and branding takes hours; general chat tools do not edit native PowerPoint files.
business_model: B2C and team SaaS subscription (third-party listing shows Pro at $16 per month billed annually, unverified)

founders.name: Apoorve Singhal
education: IIT Kharagpur, studying CS and AI
previous_startups: BookMySlot and Auto-OTP (products used by 10,000+ users per YC page)
founders.background_notes: AI research with scientists from Stanford, Adobe and Brown per YC page.

founders.name: Nikhil Shah
founders.role: Co-founder and CTO (per YC page, stated for Tersho)
founders.background_notes: ML and computer vision research at University of Oregon, CERN and Amazon Science labs per YC page.

competitors.name: Beautiful.ai
competitors.funding_then: $11M Series B in May 2018, $16M total over 4 rounds

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a native PowerPoint add-in that reads templates and brand rules is standard engineering with hard parts around layout fidelity; generative models arrived mostly after 2022.

defensibility.rationale: Plus AI, Beautiful.ai, ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot all attack the same job and the company's own site names them.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Microsoft Copilot is now a named rival on the company site; other presentation startups such as Tome shut down its slide product by April 2025, and OpenAI acquired NextSlide in August 2026.

market_need_then: Slides are a universal office task, and later tools proved heavy demand, but 2022 evidence for demand specific to this team was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Benchmark-driven claims (PPTBench) against ChatGPT, Plus AI and Copilot

rebrands.why: No source explains it; Tersho, Inc. remains the legal entity doing business as Slidely AI.

branding.community_and_virality: Listed on review sites such as G2 and Capterra; a third-party estimate shows about 13K monthly visits, unverified.

brand_strength.rationale: Easy name, but it resembles an older company named Slidely and shows little community activity.

pivots.from: Tersho (earlier product not described by sources found)
pivots.to: Slidely AI, an AI copilot for PowerPoint

outcome_analysis: Slidely AI, legally Tersho, Inc., came out of YC in Summer 2022 and has raised only small sums, mainly a Wefunder crowdfunding round around April 2023. It has about 5 people, a PowerPoint add-in, and a crowded field including Microsoft Copilot, so growth looks capital-light but unproven. No acquisition, shutdown or revenue data was found.
notes: Wefunder round: KingsCrowd says SAFE with $12M cap closed April 2023 at about $170K; CB Insights calls it a convertible note dated 1 May 2023. Stage set to other because crowdfunding SAFE is not a standard stage. CB Insights total of about $670K over three rounds is an aggregator and not recorded beyond this round. Founding year conflicts (2022 CB Insights, 2024 elsewhere). Nikhil Shah role at Slidely is not stated on the YC page, only as Tersho CTO. Pitch and Prezi are named only on undated pages, so not listed.
